fills.researcher_notes: The Nord Stream company page says the twin pipelines can carry a combined 55 billion cubic meters a year. The Nord Stream company page says the pipelines were built and are operated by Nord Stream AG. The Guardian of Aug 2022 says the company Nord Stream owns and operates the two pipelines.
